verdict.rationale: Superhuman's Snippets feature clearly lets users insert saved phrases, paragraphs, or whole emails via keyboard shortcut, and even share them with a team (docs-47, docs-48, docs-56), matching the core 'templates instead of retyping' ask. However, the evidence never documents variable/placeholder support (e.g. auto-filled name, date) or attachment bundling within a snippet, which are explicit parts of the story. Missing for 10: documentation of dynamic variables in snippets, documentation of attachments being saved/inserted with a snippet, independent/hands-on confirmation of these specifics.
